messages:
maria-platops: Heads-up: seeing ~10% spike in EU-edge embeddings 5xx over the last 10m. Root looks like the new model variant rollout + config drift. Need hotfix + expedited canary pin.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary check failed in eu-edge-2 at 1719998980 — 503 rate: 10.2%. Flagging for operator attention.
sam-dev: On it. Which service is failing? embeddings-proxy or the model runtime?
maria-platops: embeddings-proxy v2.3.1. Suspect healthcheck threadpool config got tightened in the image build.
tanya-sre: If we pin back to v2.3.0 for the canary we can contain blast radius. Ops, can you approve expedited pin so deployctl can act?
ops_oncall: I approve pin to v2.3.0 for eu-edge canary only. :thumbsup: Leaving release-owner signoff required.
julien-release: Release-owner signoff from me. Please add rollback criteria to the release note (503 <= 1% over 5m) and a brief postmortem link placeholder.
leo-eng: Metric dump from canary: cpu 62%, req/s steady, spike in 5xx right after config push at 1719998842. Pin & rollback should fix.
sam-dev: Command to pin canary (run from deploy-runner):
```
./deployctl pin --service embeddings-proxy --region eu-edge --target v2.3.0 --scope canary
```
maria-platops: Ran the pin command. deployctl: "pin accepted, awaiting approvals"
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Approval check: expedited pin requires 2 approvals. Approvals: ops_oncall, julien-release. Proceeding to apply canary pin now.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary pin applied. Starting staged rollback to v2.3.0 on 10% of canary instances.
tanya-sre: Starting healthchecks and log tailing. Will report back in ~5m.
leo-eng: Draft release note: "Hotfix: Roll back embeddings-proxy v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 in eu-edge due to 5xx spike caused by healthcheck config drift. Canary pin applied; full rollout pending stability checks."
julien-release: Add: Rollback criteria = 503 <=1% in 5m window. Contacts: ops_oncall, tanya-sre, sam-dev.
ops_oncall: Observability: 5xx down to 0.8% within ~4m after pin. Looks good. Recommend proceed to full traffic shift to v2.3.0 across eu-edge.
maria-platops: Requesting expedited full rollout (skip extended canary) to avoid customer impact. +1 from me.
sam-dev: +1 from engineering — validated traces look clean.
tanya-sre: +1. I'll stay on this channel during the shift and monitor logs.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Initiating gradual shift: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~12m. Will post updates.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Shift to 50% complete at 1719999030. 5xx = 0.6%.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Shift to 100% complete at 1719999052. 5xx = 0.2%.
maria-platops: Thanks team. Release notes updated: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/1719999000-eu-edge-embed-rollback :white_check_mark:
julien-release: Filing brief incident note and adding postmortem placeholder.
maria-platops: Closing thread once 15m stable. Handing monitoring to ops_oncall.
ops_oncall: I'll monitor. If >1% 5xx spike occurs, escalate and trigger emergency rollback to previous stable (v2.2.8) and page the on-call SREs.
